result.markdown: --- gd-head-tags: - >- ``{=html} open-graph: title: >- [ADaMVariableSpec]{.doc-object-name .doc-class .doc-label .doc-label-dataclass} | Pointblank description: The specification of one variable in an ADaM dataset template. twitter-card: title: >- [ADaMVariableSpec]{.doc-object-name .doc-class .doc-label .doc-label-dataclass} | Pointblank description: The specification of one variable in an ADaM dataset template. title: >- [ADaMVariableSpec]{.doc-object-name .doc-class .doc-label .doc-label-dataclass} body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 bread-crumbs: false toc-depth: 3 description-meta: The specification of one variable in an ADaM dataset template. page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} The specification of one variable in an ADaM dataset template. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/posit-dev/pointblank/blob/main/pointblank/metadata/_adam_templates.py#L16-L90){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-class} ```pythonsignature ADaMVariableSpec( name, label, dtype, core="Perm", required=False, max_length=None, controlled_term=None, source=None, condition=None, is_population_flag=False, ) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} An [`ADaMDatasetTemplate`](`pointblank.ADaMDatasetTemplate`) holds an `ADaMVariableSpec` for each variable of its dataset, in its `variables` list. The specification gives the variable's label, type and core designation, the condition under which a conditionally required variable is needed, where its values come from, and whether it is a population flag. [`validate_adam()`](`pointblank.validate_adam`) uses `required` and `is_population_flag` to decide which checks to make. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [name]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The variable name, such as `"USUBJID"`, `"PARAMCD"` or `"AVAL"`. [label]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The variable label, such as `"Unique Subject Identifier"`. [dtype]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The data type: `"Char"` for character variables or `"Num"` for numeric ones (including dates, which ADaM stores as numbers). [core]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [["Perm"]{.st}]{.doc-parameter-default} : The core designation: `"Req"` (required), `"Cond"` (conditionally required: needed when the condition in `condition` holds) or `"Perm"` (permissible). The default is `"Perm"`. [required]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[False]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Whether the variable is required in every dataset of this type. In the templates, this is `True` exactly when `core` is `"Req"`. The default is `False`. [max_length]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : The maximum length of the values of a character variable. The default is `None` (no maximum). [controlled_term]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : The name of the controlled terminology codelist for the variable's values, such as `"NY"` for the population flags. The default is `None`. [source]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Where the variable's values come from, such as `"SDTM.DM"` (copied from the Demographics domain) or `"Derived from SDTM.EX"`. The default is `None` (not specified). [condition]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : For a conditionally required variable, a description of when it is required, such as `"Required if safety population defined"`. The default is `None`. [is_population_flag]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[False]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Whether the variable is a population flag (such as `SAFFL` or `ITTFL`), whose values must be `"Y"` or `"N"`. The default is `False`. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Specifications are usually taken from a template. Here is the one for the safety population flag, `SAFFL`, in the ADSL template: ::: {#d1ff1090 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import pointblank as pb saffl = pb.get_adam_dataset("ADSL").get_variable("SAFFL") saffl ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` ADaMVariableSpec(name='SAFFL', label='Safety Population Flag', dtype='Char', core='Cond', required=False, max_length=1, controlled_term='NY', source=None, condition='Required if safety population defined', is_population_flag=True) ``` ::: ::: `SAFFL` is a one-character population flag with values from the `NY` codelist. It is conditionally required, and `condition` says when: whenever the study defines a safety population. ## See Also {.doc-see-also} [](`~ADaMDatasetTemplate`) : The template that holds the specifications of a dataset's variables. [](`~SDTMVariableSpec`) : The equivalent for SDTM domain templates.
